title: MachineReviewEnvelope
description: RA-12 (intake-1004). The immutable, version-correct binding of ONE machine review (a model-emitted review body) to the exact inputs it was produced against. Distinct from DecisionEnvelope (the deterministic policy reducer's decision): this envelope records what a MODEL said and about WHICH bytes. A review is current ONLY for the exact source + candidate content hash and version, prompt bundle, pipeline version and review-schema version recorded in `binding`; any change to one of them makes the review STALE until re-run. A stale envelope is retained as history and is never spliced into a current view. Tamper evidence: `binding_digest` is the canonical sha256 over `binding`, and the review body itself is SIGNED with the same digest (`signed_body.binding_digest`), so an old body re-wrapped in an envelope that claims current inputs fails validation. Machine-generated objections are typed `unverified_lead` until a current primary artifact or an objective verifier resolves them, and they never count as independent corroboration. Validator: src/proactive_delegation/review_envelope.py.

binding_digest.description: Canonical sha256 over `binding` (sorted-key compact JSON). Recomputed on validation; a mismatch means the binding was edited after the review was signed.

output_hash.description: Canonical sha256 over the SIGNED review body `{binding_digest, review}`. The body travels separately; the validator refuses a body whose hash differs.

validation_status.description: Outcome of validating the review body against `binding.review_schema_version` AT EMISSION. Never mutated; staleness is derived at read time against current inputs, never written here (immutable structure).

supersedes.description: envelope_id of the prior envelope this re-run replaces, or null for a first review. The superseded envelope is retained unchanged as stale history.

source.description: The primary material the review is about (spec, abstract, task statement).

candidate.description: The artifact under review (diff, answer, package).

review_schema_version.description: Version of the schema the review BODY is validated against (e.g. review_decision.schema.json).

status.description: A machine objection is an unverified_lead until a CURRENT primary artifact or an objective verifier resolves it.

independent_corroboration.description: Machine-generated objections are never independent corroboration, whatever their status.
